summary: Iteration 11 testing complete. Full backend + frontend validation of per-chapter music, WYSIWYG rich chapters, and reader preferences panel. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows all green: chapter reader opens, prefs persist to localStorage across reload, dropcap renders on legacy plain-text chapters, WYSIWYG editor applies bold+H2 and preserves images on save (backend round-trip test proves poster/bg not wiped). Mobile detail no horizontal overflow. All required data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 659 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting routers by resource (creations, chapters, ambiences, settings) into modules.

RichTextEditor uses deprecated document.execCommand — functional today but flagged obsolete by browsers; consider migrating to a modern rich-text lib (Tiptap/ProseMirror/Lexical) before it degrades further.

sanitize() in RichTextEditor is very light (regex-based, only strips <script>/<style>/on-attrs). Since content is rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in ChapterReader, an XSS-hardened sanitizer like DOMPurify would be safer, even for a single-user app.

In ChapterReader.trackFor useEffect, the dependency array is [idx] only (with eslint-disable); if item.has_reading_audio flips or chapter has_music updates without idx changing, the track won't re-resolve. Minor edge case.
Chapter model default has_music=false is fine, but the backend does not currently expose an endpoint to bulk-migrate legacy chapters — not required, just noting.

Admin via localStorage sx_admin=1 + sx_pin=1234. Home card requires click-then-Enter (or Enter) to navigate to /oeuvre/{id}; single click only focuses the card. Backend chapter audio endpoints: POST/GET/DELETE /api/creations/{cid}/chapters/{chid}/audio — verified with 200/404/413. rich round-trip: PUT /api/creations/{cid} with chapter.rich=true and HTML content persists as-is; poster/bg preserved when caller sends them back (which frontend does via getCreationFull's media=1). All reader-prefs keys write to localStorage: sx_reader_font/size/line/width/dropcap; line only persists if changed by user.
